commits.subject: feat(pic0): descend finite Galois representability
commits.summary: **Conditional producer.** Composes quotient, equivariant, invariant, and base Picard Hom equivalences to descend a finite-level representer when the canonical action has affine-contained orbits.

commits.subject: feat(pic0): match Galois invariants with equivariant maps
commits.summary: **Descent seam.** Identifies Pic0 Galois-invariant sections with equivariant morphisms and proves compatibility with precomposition.
